description:
Kim Woo-jin, a typical hard worker who is sincere in his duties and kind to his lovers. One day, she is dumped by her lover, whom she has been dating for seven years and even thought about getting married, for lack of sexual attraction, and due to the shock, she lives with the alcohol she usually stays away from. Then, a joint dinner with the participating marketing department. Woojin confronts him, who is famous for being gay and out of the company. An elite with a reputation for unrivaled work ability. The man with a beautiful appearance that goes beyond rumors and a charisma that overwhelms those who tell rude jokes.
